color_picker.eyedropper: Pick a color from the screen

server_errors.account_deactivated: This account is deactivated. Contact your workspace administrator.
server_errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the workspace.
server_errors.already_member_self: You are already a member of this workspace — just open it.
server_errors.auth_method_disabled: This sign-in method is not enabled on this server. Use one of the methods offered on the sign-in page.
server_errors.code_rate_limited: A code has just been sent. Wait a minute before asking for a new one.
server_errors.corporate_email_missing: Your corporate record carries no email address, and an account needs one. Ask your administrator to add it.
server_errors.corporate_email_unverified: An account with this address already exists, and your directory does not confirm the address belongs to you. Ask your administrator to link the accounts.
server_errors.corporate_login_failed: Corporate sign-in could not be completed. Try again, or sign in another way.
server_errors.email_domain_not_allowed: This address is not allowed on this server. Sign in with your work email, or ask an administrator to allow your domain.
server_errors.email_not_configured: This server has no email delivery configured — contact your administrator.
server_errors.insufficient_permissions: You do not have the rights for this action.
server_errors.invalid_or_expired_code: That code is wrong or no longer valid. Request a new one.
server_errors.invitation_already_pending: An invitation to this address is already waiting for an answer.
server_errors.invitation_expired: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
server_errors.invitation_not_found: The invitation could not be found — it may have been revoked.
server_errors.invitation_not_pending: This invitation has already been answered.
server_errors.invitation_not_yours: This invitation was sent to a different address. Sign in with the email it was sent to.
server_errors.ldap_not_configured: Directory sign-in is not finished being set up on this server — contact your administrator.
server_errors.ldap_unavailable: The corporate directory did not answer. Try again in a minute, or sign in another way.
server_errors.mfa_already_enrolled: A second factor is already active. Turn it off with a current code before setting up a new one.
server_errors.mfa_code_replayed: That code has already been used. Wait for your app to show the next one.
server_errors.mfa_invalid_code: That code is wrong. Check the code in your authenticator app and try again.
server_errors.mfa_not_enrolled: No second factor is set up on this account.
server_errors.mfa_pending_invalid: This sign-in has expired. Start again from the sign-in page.
server_errors.mfa_unavailable: This server cannot store a second factor — contact your administrator.
server_errors.oidc_not_configured: Corporate sign-in is not finished being set up on this server — contact your administrator.
server_errors.oidc_provider_refused: The corporate identity provider did not complete the sign-in. Try again, or contact your administrator.
server_errors.oidc_provider_unavailable: The corporate identity provider did not answer. Try again in a minute, or sign in another way.
server_errors.oidc_state_invalid: The sign-in took too long or was already completed. Start again from the sign-in page.
server_errors.oidc_token_invalid: The corporate identity provider's response failed verification. Try again, or contact your administrator.
server_errors.signup_disabled: This server is not taking new accounts. Ask an administrator to send you an invitation.
server_errors.workspace_creation_disabled: On this server new workspaces are created by an administrator.
server_errors.workspace_slug_invalid: The address may contain only lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
server_errors.workspace_slug_reserved: That address is reserved — pick another one.
server_errors.workspace_slug_taken: That workspace address is already taken — pick another one.

slack_bind.done_description: Your next message to the bot in Slack will go straight to the agent. You can close this tab.
slack_bind.error_admin_hint: If this keeps happening, message the bot again in Slack to get a fresh link.
slack_bind.error_already_bound: This Slack account is already linked to a different Goosar user. Account transfers must go through an explicit unbind first.
slack_bind.error_expired: This link is invalid or expired (links are valid for 15 minutes). Message the bot again to get a new one.
slack_bind.error_missing_token: The link is missing its token. Message the bot again in Slack to get a new one.
slack_bind.error_not_member: You're signed in to a Goosar account that isn't a member of this workspace.
slack_bind.error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and if the problem persists, contact the workspace admin.
slack_bind.needs_auth_description: Sign in to Goosar to complete the link. The token in the link binds your Slack account to this Goosar user, so you must be logged in first.
